name: Acceptance suite-3 test 74 - wildcard modifier resource overlaps an exact assumable role
note: IAM-1003 (Phase 10): the modify legs (iam:PutRolePolicy + iam:UpdateAssumeRolePolicy) are scoped to a role-path WILDCARD (role/deployment/*) while sts:AssumeRole names the CONCRETE role/deployment/Prod. The wildcard subsumes the concrete role, so the compound role-takeover chain is viable and MUST correlate - anchored on the concrete intersecting role deployment/Prod, NOT generalized to deployment/*. Correlation is by overlap, not exact-string match.
